kpis.description: IVR organized its inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, bringing together 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany to discuss technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland shipping. Eight presentations covered topics including collision prevention, safety culture, decarbonization impacts, hull damage trends, and clean shipping solutions. The event was moderated by Ronald Koops, chair of the IVR Loss Prevention Committee, emphasizing the importance of collaboration and knowledge exchange in a rapidly evolving sector focused on sustainability and technical innovation.

The 2024 IVR Annual Congress held May 15-17 in Frankfurt attracted 225 participants from 11 European countries. The congress featured a workshop on 'Navigating into the future, the value and versatility of inland waterways' with presentations on vessel safety, legal frameworks, sustainability, and clean shipping solutions. The general assembly took place aboard the Maria Sibylla Merian, where General Secretary Frouwke de Vries reviewed IVR activities including collaboration with ZKR and European Commission, focus on emissions and climate change, and ongoing projects. The event concluded with networking activities and dinners.

ai_positioning.summary: IVR is a trade association for European inland waterway shipping, insurance and survey sectors. No AI initiatives, tools or applications are mentioned in the 2024 annual report. The organization focuses on industry representation, standards development, loss prevention, and member networking through international collaboration with ZKR, European Commission, CESNI, IUMI, and CMI.
